example: By the way, I love your bag.
example_zh: 對了，我好喜歡你的包包。
tip_zh: the 要輕輕伸出舌尖，不是 de

example: Anyway, I should go. See you!
example_zh: 總之我該走了，再見！

example: Actually, I'm from Kaohsiung.
example_zh: 其實我是高雄人。

example: Really? That's amazing!
example_zh: 真的嗎？太厲害了！
tip_zh: 語調要往上揚，表示驚訝或有興趣

example: Have you been busy lately?
example_zh: 你最近忙嗎？

example: It was, you know, a little strange.
example_zh: 那個……你知道的，有點怪。
tip_zh: 想下一個字時可以用，但別每句都說

example: I'm kind of tired today.
example_zh: 我今天有點累。

example: My week was pretty good, thanks.
example_zh: 我這週還不錯，謝謝。
tip_zh: pretty 在這裡是「蠻」，不是「漂亮」

example: Same here. I need a vacation too.
example_zh: 我也是，我也需要放個假。

example: Let me see... I think it was Tuesday.
example_zh: 我想想……應該是星期二。
tip_zh: 想答案時說這句，比沉默自然

example: Well, it's a long story.
example_zh: 嗯，說來話長。

english: What have you been up to?
example: Long time no see! What have you been up to?
example_zh: 好久不見！你最近在忙什麼？

example: Good morning! How was your weekend?
example_zh: 早安！你週末過得怎麼樣？

example: I'm a teacher. How about you?
example_zh: 我是老師，那你呢？
tip_zh: about you 連起來唸 a-bow-choo

english: Is it always this busy here?
chinese: 這裡一直都這麼多人嗎？
example: Wow, so many people. Is it always this busy here?
example_zh: 哇，好多人。這裡一直都這麼多人嗎？
tip_zh: is it 連起來唸成 i-zit

example: You went camping? That sounds fun!
example_zh: 你去露營？聽起來很好玩！
tip_zh: sounds 結尾的 /ndz/ 要發清楚

example: You speak Japanese? Oh, I didn't know that.
example_zh: 你會說日文？喔，我都不知道耶。

example: Do you live around here? I'm on Zhongshan Road.
example_zh: 你住這附近嗎？我住中山路。
tip_zh: live 是短音 /ɪ/，不要唸成 leave

english: It was nice talking to you.
example: I have to go. It was nice talking to you!
example_zh: 我得走了，很高興跟你聊天！
tip_zh: talking 的 l 不發音

example: Oh, it's late. I'd better get going.
example_zh: 喔，好晚了，我差不多該走了。
tip_zh: better 的 tt 唸成輕快的 d 音
